claim_map.title: Centralization target
claim_map.text: NAMS consolidation proposes Data Ops maintenance in SSI+. RATAN must query SSI+ for cashflow, trade, and accounting Nostro stamping. New, Update, and Delete notifications must trigger refresh. Schemas and mappings remain open, including NOS versus Nostro terminology. Historical cashflow-linked Nostro IDs require a migration decision. RFI portfolio mapping and Keystone are related work, without proven rollout.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: Atomic CSV import proposal
claim_map.text: POST /v2/static/nostros/upload accepts a CSV file and directConfirm. Invalid content rejects the whole file. The listed duplicate key combines legalEntityFmId, currency, settlementMeans, settlementAccount, startDate, and endDate. The success response uses status 200 and the uploaded count in errorMessage. The failure example uses status 400 and errorCode 800400117. directConfirm true selects save_confirmed; false selects update_pending. No operator authorization is specified.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: Dedicated lookup architecture
claim_map.text: The dedicated-Nostro design finally selects memory plus database lookup, despite stating a preference for memory-only. It prefers a child table with jsonb for dedicated data. New Nostro types still require user matching conditions, code, and mapping changes. This is not configuration-only support for arbitrary types. Compare returned dedicated Nostro IDs for current New and Withdrawal messages to classify amendment changes. Technical failure in a NonEcoAmend group must become economic; other named amendment branches retain their stated handling.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: Conflicting technical decisions
claim_map.text: Technical Q8 says no RFI match produces Missing Nostro; the functional view instead falls back to ordinary stamping. Technical Q11 removes Vostro/Nostro means/account matching for RFI; the functional view retains SI mismatch. Early technical questions include five entrypoints, while later answers exclude trade stamping. KRO and KOR literals differ. Early nostrumType/nostroKey uniqueness differs from the final five-factor rule. Q28 says no migration; Q31 requires DEFAULT population and conversion of existing RFI records. Retain these alternatives until owner review.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: Proposed service interfaces
claim_map.text: Static service adds NostroType and dedicated information, findDedicated for SSI, and findDedicateds for group amendment classification. Empty query NostroType fetches all types. Lifecycle domain events and /v2/ratan/cashflow/move/status responses include NostroType. Query detail exposes Nostro_Type and Dedicated. Adhoc maker/checker fitNostro includes nostroType and dedicatedPortfolio. MT210 tag25 applies when currency is KRW and the correspondent account exists. Example account and address literals are excluded.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: Functional RFI selection and exceptions
claim_map.text: The London RFI proposal stamps dedicated Korea Nostro by portfolio and currency. Portfolio is mandatory for RFI records; Primary is disabled. Duplicate checking uses booking entity, currency, means, account, and Nostro type. Query with booking entity, currency, and portfolio. Stamp a single match; multiple matches generate Missing Nostro; no match follows the ordinary process. Keep Vostro logic unchanged and prevent it from overwriting the selected Nostro. SI mismatch remains required when Vostro/Nostro means or accounts differ.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: Functional amendment and manual scope
claim_map.text: A non-RFI/RFI portfolio change is economic. Indicator lookup technical failure defaults to economic change. Cashflow stamping is in scope; trade stamping stays BAU until the separate strategic solution. Adhoc selection may select an RFI Nostro even for a non-RFI portfolio. Show Nostro Type in selection and cashflow detail. MT210 tag25 takes the Nostro account only for ISO currency KRW. Proposed downstream integration testing is a requirement, without execution evidence.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.
